description: This file defines a React functional component 'HeroCarousel' that implements a lightweight accessible carousel with three slides. It handles auto-rotation, manual slide controls, and indicators using React hooks such as useState, useRef, and useEffect. The component manages internal state for current slide index, uses CSS classes for styling, and incorporates ARIA attributes for accessibility.

methods.name: go
methods.description: Navigates to the previous or next slide based on the direction parameter (-1 for previous, 1 for next).
